snippet.title: Project FOXX Combat Showcase Trailer.
snippet.description:
Description
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4115320/Project_Foxx/

Project Foxx is a fast-paced Hack & Shoot Action Platformer built in Unreal Engine 5.
Play as Officer Foxx, a fearless hero of the C.L.A.W. Department, bringing justice with style in a vibrant sci-fi world.

⚡ Core Features
• Fast-paced melee and ranged combat (Hack & Shoot system)
• Platforming, traversal, and momentum-based movement
• Stylized environments powered by Unreal Engine 5
• A world that celebrates hope, courage, and heroism

🎮 Status: Pre-Alpha Gameplay
🛠️ Work in progress — visuals and gameplay subject to change.
📩 For collaborations or inquiries: Contact@studioshoora.com

🔗 Follow for updates:
YouTube → https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCV1eSis76tJjudI-aGtPXGA
Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4115320/Project_Foxx/

🦊 Project Foxx is an independently developed game by Saurav Bhagat.
